abstract: In sub‐Saharan Africa, agriculture is vital; however, the systematic exclusion of persons with disabilities from farming hinders sustainable development and social equity. Although several studies have analyzed productivity differentials across various dimensions of social exclusion, empirical evidence on technology access, farming efficiency, and productivity gaps among farmers with disabilities remains limited. This study addresses this gap by evaluating disparities in crop production between farmers with and without disabilities in Ghana, with a particular focus on differences in technology endowment and production efficiency. Utilizing the meta‐stochastic frontier analysis coupled with statistical matching techniques on nationally representative farm‐level data from the 2012/13 and 2016/17 agricultural seasons, we find negligible differences in technical efficiency between the two groups (less than 0.5%). However, the productive capacity of the technology sets employed by farmers with disabilities is approximately 11%‐point lower than that of their counterparts without disability, resulting in a 9.5%‐point shortfall in crop production. This production shortfall is primarily driven by reduced per‐hectare use of critical inputs such as planting materials, labor, fertilizer, and agro‐chemicals. These findings highlight a significant disability‐associated technology access gap that reflects broader structural inequalities. Addressing these disparities is essential for promoting equitable agricultural development while harnessing the full potential of all farmers in Ghana.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，农业至关重要；然而，残疾人被系统性地排斥在农业生产之外，阻碍了可持续发展与社会公平。尽管已有研究分析了社会排斥不同维度下的生产率差异，但关于残疾农民在技术获取、耕作效率及生产率差距方面的实证证据仍然有限。本研究通过评估加纳残疾与非残疾农民在作物生产中的差异，特别是技术禀赋与生产效率的差异，填补了这一空白。基于2012/13和2016/17农业季全国代表性农户层面数据，采用元随机前沿分析结合统计匹配技术，我们发现两组农民的技术效率差异微乎其微（低于0.5%）。然而，残疾农民所采用技术集的生产能力比非残疾农民低约11个百分点，导致作物产量减少9.5个百分点。这一产量缺口主要源于种植材料、劳动力、化肥及农用化学品等关键投入要素的每公顷使用量减少。这些发现揭示了与残疾相关的显著技术获取差距，反映了更广泛的结构性不平等。解决这些差距对于促进公平的农业发展、同时充分发挥加纳所有农民的潜力至关重要。
title: Production Gaps Among Farmers With Disabilities Are Associated With Limited Technology
title_zh: 残疾农民的生产差距与有限技术相关

abstract: Price volatility in agricultural markets directly affects the financial viability of rural producers, particularly in sectors characterized by narrow profit margins and long production cycles, such as beef cattle production. Futures contracts and agricultural insurance are commonly used to mitigate this risk; however, both instruments are exposed to basis risk, which arises from the divergences between futures and spot prices. This article has two objectives: to estimate the basis risk of futures contracts for fed cattle, feeder cattle, and corn, and to assess the basis risk associated with designing a gross margin insurance product adapted to the Brazilian context. The results show that basis risk for fed cattle and corn contracts was lower in São Paulo (7.51% and 4.85%, respectively) than in Mato Grosso do Sul (11.34% and 5.79%). Using state‐level prices as a proxy for feeder cattle futures reduced basis risk in both states, although the São Paulo proxy exhibited higher relative basis risk. The basis risk of the gross margin insurance product was estimated at 31.23% in São Paulo and 32.39% in Mato Grosso do Sul. These findings indicate that incorporating regional price differentials into margin insurance valuation is an effective policy strategy to reduce basis risk, allowing insured margins to better reflect local market conditions without introducing new futures contracts.
abstract_zh: 农产品市场价格波动直接影响农村生产者的财务可持续性，尤其在利润率低、生产周期长的行业（如肉牛养殖）中表现显著。期货合约和农业保险常被用于缓解此类风险，但两者均面临基差风险——即期货价格与现货价格之间的偏差。本文旨在实现两个目标：估算育肥牛、架子牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险，并评估适用于巴西背景的总利润保险产品设计中的基差风险。结果表明，圣保罗州育肥牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险（分别为7.51%和4.85%）低于南马托格罗索州（分别为11.34%和5.79%）。以州级价格作为架子牛期货的代理变量降低了两个州的基差风险，但圣保罗州的代理变量表现出更高的相对基差风险。总利润保险产品的基差风险在圣保罗州为31.23%，在南马托格罗索州为32.39%。这些发现表明，将区域价格差异纳入利润保险估值是降低基差风险的有效政策策略，可在不引入新期货合约的情况下，使保险利润更准确地反映当地市场条件。
title: Assessing Basis Risk in Margin Insurance for Beef Cattle Farming in Brazil
title_zh: 评估巴西肉牛养殖利润保险中的基差风险

abstract: About one‐quarter of the global population, that is, approximately 1.8 billion people, with 90% in low‐ and middle‐income countries, face substantial weather‐related risks. This paper studies how weather shocks are associated with crop diversification and household food security in Nigeria, with a focus on gendered plot management. We merge historical climate data with the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study—Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (LSMS‐ISA) to construct rainfall anomaly (z‐score) and temperature extreme (Killing Degree Days, KDD) measures, household crop diversification, and household food security indicators. Using a Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model, we find that both rainfall shocks and extreme temperatures are negatively associated with household dietary diversity, but the relationship is mixed for other food security outcomes. Crop diversification is positively associated with food security under high temperature exposure, but the relationship is mixed under rainfall anomalies. The gender composition of household plot managers does not show a statistically robust moderating role in the aggregate; however, gender differences emerge at certain thresholds of weather exposure. The results highlight the heterogeneity in the crop diversification—food security relationship across weather dimensions.
abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一人口（约18亿人）面临重大气候相关风险，其中90%生活在低收入和中等收入国家。本文以尼日利亚为研究对象，聚焦地块管理的性别差异，探讨天气冲击与作物多样化及家庭粮食安全之间的关联。我们将历史气候数据与世界银行生活标准测量研究——农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA）相结合，构建了降雨异常（z-score）和极端温度（致死度日，KDD）指标，以及家庭作物多样化和粮食安全指标。采用双向固定效应（TWFE）模型研究发现，降雨冲击和极端温度均与家庭膳食多样性呈负相关，但与其他粮食安全指标的关系则呈现混合特征。在高温暴露条件下，作物多样化与粮食安全呈正相关，但在降雨异常情境下两者关系复杂。从总体来看，家庭地块管理者的性别构成并未表现出统计上稳健的调节作用；然而，在特定天气暴露阈值下，性别差异开始显现。研究结果揭示了作物多样化与粮食安全关系在不同天气维度上的异质性。
title: Heterogeneous Effects of Weather Shocks and Crop Diversification on Household Food Security. A Gender Dimension
title_zh: 天气冲击与作物多样化对家庭粮食安全的异质性影响：性别维度

abstract: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究信贷摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导路径中，抵押约束引发的资本需求波动会通过资本与劳动的互补性溢出至劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘。从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反向传导路径中，搜寻摩擦导致工资变动幅度小于生产率变动幅度，这通过工资账单渠道加剧了净值的波动性，进而溢出至资本需求。两种机制共同作用，显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。
title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
title_zh: 信贷与劳动力市场摩擦的相互作用

abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据

abstract: This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金资本供给如何影响市政债券融资，并作出三项关键贡献。首先，我们引入一种基于晨星评级规则更新的识别策略（针对成立满五年的基金），从而将供给端效应与基金及发行人的基本面因素相分离。结果表明，外生性基金流入会提高债券发行概率并降低收益率。其次，当基金与发行人通过承销商建立关联时，此类基金流入会带来更多债券发行，凸显了市政债券融资中的关系型借贷特征。第三，市政发行人利用有利融资条件发行收益债券，进而推高当地房价。（JEL分类号：G23, G32, H74）
title: Mutual Fund Flows and the Supply of Capital in Municipal Financing
title_zh: 共同基金流动与市政融资中的资本供给

abstract: Direct public funding of R&D investment to stimulate technological innovation has a strong theoretical case and has gained renewed attention in recent times as a way to address the long-term challenges of modern society, such as economic growth, climate change, energy independence, and national security. We estimate the dynamic macroeconomic effects of government R&D investment and we find that it is very effective in fostering the national innovation effort by crowding in private R&D investment and raising aggregate output in the long run, but also that it stimulates a strong expansion from the outset, in particular through anticipation effects.
abstract_zh: 直接公共资助研发投资以刺激技术创新具有坚实的理论依据，近年来作为应对现代社会长期挑战（如经济增长、气候变化、能源独立和国家安全）的手段重新受到关注。我们估算了政府研发投资的动态宏观经济效应，发现其通过挤入私人研发投资并在长期内提高总产出，对促进国家创新努力非常有效，同时从初期就激发了强劲的经济扩张，尤其是通过预期效应发挥作用。
title: Macroeconomic Effects of Public R&D
title_zh: 公共研发的宏观经济效应
